description: Eindhoven University of Technology publishes a physics-based MATLAB simulation tool for battery-electric vehicle energy consumption. Its velocity-profile algorithm and energy-consumption model are based on dedicated vehicle tests. The supplied vehicle parameters describe a Voltia eVan delivery van with a swappable traction battery. The source identifies route, elevation and weather inputs obtained through Overpass OpenStreetMap, SRTM and OpenWeatherMap. The release contents and related resources follow the native description above. Coverage: The reviewed metadata does not establish a complete common temporal interval. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData descriptive metadata identifies this release. Licence: BSD-3-Clause. Cost and current distribution access remain unknown. Caveats: The original title states 0.1; the native description identifies version 0.1.3 dated 23 August 2021. Its API access and bug-fix changelog are historical source claims. No live route, elevation or weather request was made. Current credentials, access and execution remain unverified.
